name: Sanjou Yuuri
source:
A capable and driven woman who serves as President Kakimoto’s secretary.
She’s a beautiful woman who comes across as a bit stern; at first glance, she seems cool and unapproachable, but in reality, she’s sociable, flexible in her thinking, and highly skilled at navigating social situations.
She possesses an alluring physique, and her voluptuous bust, in particular, is to die for. With her unique aura—part queen, part mother—there is no end to the men within the organization who admire Yuri.
However, she seems to have no real interest in romance; no matter how much they try to pursue her, she skillfully deflects any advances beyond a certain point.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110528010142/http://www.turumiku.jp/osaka/yuuri.html]official site[/url]]
